title: H-D Sportster S 1250 (Classic Heritage)
description: Representing Harley-Davidson's prowess in the Performance Cruiser class, the Harley-Davidson H-D Sportster S 1250 (Classic Heritage) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 1250cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
